assessment: The manuscript shows striking data that circulating innate lymphoid cells (ILCs) decline over human age, more in males than in females, and that a further decline in their prominence is associated with severe COVID-19 in both elderly and paediatric situations. While the findings remain correlative as yet, they shed further light on the complex immune dysregulation of COVID-19, and underline the potential importance of innate lymphoid cells.
